summary: Preserved candidate PR 3500's valid composite decode-offload and LMCache diagnostic changes, then corrected its concrete omission of DEEPSEEK_V4_C128_STATE from decode sidecar enumeration. The correction was reproduced against exact candidate commit fb34ada0b8d8b9db3ee04ecd4c82c563db4c0cdd and adds a constructor-level regression. LMCache grouped transfer remains externally unsupported and is not claimed fixed.

tests.what_was_measured: Before correction, the actual DecodeKVCacheOffloadManager constructor omitted DEEPSEEK_V4_C128_STATE even though the composite host group exposed that entry; raw output is candidate_c128_before.txt.
After correction, DecodeKVCacheOffloadManager enumerated DEEPSEEK_V4_C128_STATE as an SWA-derived sidecar; raw output is candidate_c128_after.txt.
27 tests and 8 subtests passed, covering decode offload lifetime/accounting, constructor enumeration, and composite device-pool layouts.
Exact device-to-pinned-host byte equality for three paged and two ring-state synthetic buffers on one AMD Instinct MI350X; this does not qualify V4 model correctness.

gpu_execution.evidence: gpu_composite_transfer_after.txt reports exact=True for all five tested buffers on AMD Instinct MI350X with HIP 7.2.26015.

remaining_limitations: LMCache DeepSeek-V4 operation remains blocked on an external grouped connector and transfer protocol accepting pool_group; the candidate provides capability probing and a precise NotImplementedError only.

No DeepSeek-V4 weights or B300 distributed PD environment were available, so V4 attention correctness, real request lifetime behavior, storage restore, unified-KV, HiSparse, and multi-rank behavior remain unverified.
The GPU evidence is a synthetic transfer-primitive test, not an end-to-end model or LMCache daemon test.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json specifies native=null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
